summary: Reproducible and internally consistent. The original $51 was built on incomplete information: the skills-only stack had no web access and missed the OpenAI 750MW deal and AWS program that anchor the UBS thesis. Rebuilt on a risk-adjusted OpenAI ramp, fair value is $134, and our bull scenario ($255) lands near UBS's $300, so the remaining gap is deliberate execution-risk weighting (the 10x supply-chain scale-up, OpenAI concentration, NVDA/Groq response, lock-up), not a disagreement on the technology or the deal's existence. Deal terms are UBS-sourced rather than primary-filing-verified; this is the main residual soft spot and is flagged in data_gaps.
